description: This file declares interface functions and includes headers for nl80211 API wrapper in a wireless device management context. It defines functions related to management frame transmission, station configuration, interface info retrieval, and station info retrieval, specific to a certain endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_sendManagementFrameCmd
methods.description: Sends a management frame command over nl80211 for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_setSta
methods.description: Configures station-related parameters for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_set4Mac
methods.description: Sets 4 Mac configuration for a specific endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getInterfaceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves interface information, including MLO link info, for a given endpoint.

methods.name: wld_ep_nl80211_getStationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves station information for a remote AP associated with the endpoint.
